## CORE RULE 5. Don't attempt to evade bans, and don't use alt accounts or share account.
Any attempt to circumvent or bypass a game ban will result in a voucher ban. Attempting to evade role bans by taking on a similar role as a job you are banned from will result in a game ban, unless you are an antagonist using it as an advantage to complete objectives.
Almost all bans have a chance to be appealed on our discord server where you are able to open a ticket to contact the admin team. If you are voucher banned you’ll need another server’s admin team to vouch for your improved behavior for us to consider lifting the ban.
If you share your account with others you are responsible for, and will remain accountable for, any bans or notes tied to it. In order for us to prevent ban evasion, you are not allowed to switch between accounts ("multikey") even if they are not used during the same period of time. If you lose access to an account you must contact game admins and notify them before using a new account to connect to the servers. This is especially important if you have any history of bans or notes tied to your old account and may result in a permanent ban otherwise.
